answer: Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the nebula registry records each claim and the haven audit publishes every slash. A farm must therefore either lie, which the dawn graph proves on replay, or recruit 94 outsiders whose stake is exposed alongside its own. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 32% of the attester's bond. That is 6 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
